metrics.name: Adopted ASVS verification
metrics.numerator: Applicable adopted requirements with scoped passing evidence, verifier and date
metrics.denominator: All adopted applicable requirements; unknown applicability remains backlog

metrics.name: Unaccepted release findings
metrics.numerator: Open critical/high findings without current sponsor-approved scoped exception

metrics.name: Privileged access review
metrics.numerator: Privileged identities with completed current access review
metrics.denominator: All privileged identities in approved scope

metrics.name: Recovery effectiveness
metrics.numerator: Consistent successful restores meeting approved RTO/RPO and integrity checks
metrics.target: All required exercises successful; failures block acceptance

metrics.name: Audit checkpoint verification
metrics.numerator: Required chain/checkpoint checks with retained successful result
metrics.data_source: Audit verifier and independently protected checkpoints

metrics.name: Finding response timeliness
metrics.numerator: Findings closed/retested within adopted severity response target

release_gates: Sponsor-approved scope, roles, ASVS target and applicability
Exact commit/artifact/lockfiles and retained scan evidence
All adopted applicable requirements verified; failures/unknowns tracked
Actual benchmark/TLS/storage/deployment and monitoring checks validated
Approved recovery objectives and successful scoped restore/rollback evidence
Independent review and sponsor release authorization
interpretation: Evidence metrics are not breach probabilities or ISO assurance conformance. Null baseline means unmeasured, not zero risk or maturity.
